### BookingState {#type-commerz-shipping-bookings-enums-bookingstate}

`Commerz\Shipping\Bookings\Enums\BookingState`

`pending` while one process talks to the carrier under a lease; then `booked` (final), `rejected` (the carrier created nothing; booking again may change the payload) or `unknown` (the carrier may have created the shipment; booking again looks it up first).

```php
enum BookingState {
    case Pending = 'pending';
    case Booked = 'booked';
    case Rejected = 'rejected';
    case Unknown = 'unknown';
}
```

### Carrier {#type-commerz-shipping-carriers-contracts-carrier}

`Commerz\Shipping\Carriers\Contracts\Carrier`

A shipping company: books shipments on request of `ShipmentBooking`.

```php
interface Carrier {
    const KIND = 'carrier';
    // Creates the shipment at the carrier. Called OUTSIDE a database transaction and free to use the network. Pass `$booking->shipment->reference` to the carrier as the sender's number when its API allows, so `find()` can find it.
    book(\Commerz\Shipping\Carriers\Data\CarrierBooking $booking): \Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\BookedShipment;
    // Looks for a shipment created earlier under the same reference (recovery after `unknown` or a lapsed lease).
    find(\Commerz\Shipping\Carriers\Data\CarrierBooking $booking): ?\Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\BookedShipment;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `manual` or `cdek`.
    key(): string;
}
```

### Methods {#type-commerz-shipping-methods-contracts-methods}

`Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Contracts\Methods`

Delivery methods: a carrier, the channels that offer the method and its tariffs per zone and currency.

```php
interface Methods {
    // Final; archiving an archived method changes nothing. @throws MethodNotFound
    archive(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\ArchiveMethod $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    // Adds the channels the method is offered in; the ones it has already change nothing.
    assignChannels(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\AssignMethodChannels $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    create(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\CreateMethod $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    // Disabling a disabled method changes nothing. @throws MethodNotFound|MethodArchived
    disable(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\DisableMethod $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    // Enabling an active method changes nothing. @throws MethodNotFound|MethodArchived
    enable(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\EnableMethod $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    find(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodId $id): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    findByCode(string $code): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    list(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\ListMethods $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Replaces all the tariffs.
    setRates(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\SetMethodRates $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    // Removes channels; the ones the method does not have change nothing. @throws MethodNotFound|MethodArchived
    unassignChannels(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\UnassignMethodChannels $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
    update(\Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\UpdateMethod $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Methods\Data\MethodView;
}
```

### ShippingOptions {#type-commerz-shipping-options-contracts-shippingoptions}

`Commerz\Shipping\Options\Contracts\ShippingOptions`

Priced delivery methods for a destination and parcel, and why the others are not offered. The price is the one the delivery stage of a quote charges for the same input. `$request->parcel->value` is the value of the goods after discounts, in the context's currency: it decides free delivery above a threshold. Reads only; a failing rate plugin makes its method unavailable (`invalid_rate_result`), never the whole call.

```php
interface ShippingOptions {
    // The verdict of every method that is not archived, by code.
    explain(\Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\DeliveryRequest $request): \Commerz\Shipping\Options\Data\OptionsExplanation;
    // The available methods, by position, then price, then code; the same list as the `DeliveryOptions` port.
    list(\Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\DeliveryRequest $request): array;
}
```

### MethodVerdict {#type-commerz-shipping-options-data-methodverdict}

`Commerz\Shipping\Options\Data\MethodVerdict`

Whether one method delivers to the request and why not. `$verdict` is a stable snake_case code: `available`, `method_not_found`, `method_disabled`, `not_in_channel`, `unsupported_carrier`, `no_zone`, `no_rate_for_currency`, `unsupported_rate`, `invalid_rate_result`, or the reason a rate gave (e.g. `weight_out_of_range`). `$zoneCode` is the zone whose tariff was chosen; `$price` is set only when the method is available.

```php
final readonly class MethodVerdict {
    const AVAILABLE = 'available';
    public readonly string $message;
    public readonly string $methodCode;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Money\Money $price;
    public readonly string $verdict;
    public readonly ?string $zoneCode;
    __construct(string $methodCode, string $verdict, string $message, ?string $zoneCode = null, ?\Commerz\Money\Money $price = null);
    isAvailable(): bool;
}
```

### OptionsExplanation {#type-commerz-shipping-options-data-optionsexplanation}

`Commerz\Shipping\Options\Data\OptionsExplanation`

The verdict of every method that is not archived for one delivery request, by method code.

```php
final readonly class OptionsExplanation {
    public readonly array $methods;
    __construct(array $methods);
    method(string $methodCode): ?\Commerz\Shipping\Options\Data\MethodVerdict;
}
```

### DeliveryUnavailable {#type-commerz-shipping-options-exceptions-deliveryunavailable}

`Commerz\Shipping\Options\Exceptions\DeliveryUnavailable`

```php
    category(): \Packman\Errors\Enums\ErrorCategory;
    code(): string;
    context(): array;
    errorDescriptor(): \Packman\Errors\Data\ErrorDescriptor;
```
```php
}
```

### PackableItem {#type-commerz-shipping-packing-data-packableitem}

`Commerz\Shipping\Packing\Data\PackableItem`

A shippable line item with integer unit weight (grams), total line value, and optional 3D unit dimensions (mm).

```php
final readonly class PackableItem {
    public readonly ?int $heightMm;
    public readonly string $itemId;
    public readonly ?int $lengthMm;
    public readonly int $quantity;
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Money $totalValue;
    public readonly int $unitWeightGrams;
    public readonly ?int $widthMm;
    __construct(string $itemId, int $quantity, int $unitWeightGrams, \Commerz\Money\Money $totalValue, ?int $lengthMm = null, ?int $widthMm = null, ?int $heightMm = null);
    hasDimensions(): bool;
    static ofUnitPrice(string $itemId, int $quantity, int $unitWeightGrams, \Commerz\Money\Money $unitPrice, ?int $lengthMm = null, ?int $widthMm = null, ?int $heightMm = null): self;
    unitVolumeMm3(): \Brick\Math\BigInteger;
    // Exact integer volumetric weight of one unit in grams: `ceil((lengthMm * widthMm * heightMm) / volumetricDivisor)`. Since `1 cm³ = 1000 mm³` and `1 kg = 1000 g`, a standard `5000 cm³/kg` divisor equals `5000 mm³/g`.
    unitVolumetricWeightGrams(int $volumetricDivisor = 5000): int;
}
```

```php
    disable(string $provider, string $code): \Commerz\Shipping\PickupPoints\Data\PickupPointView;

    findView(string $provider, string $code): \Commerz\Shipping\PickupPoints\Data\PickupPointView;

    upsert(\Commerz\Shipping\PickupPoints\Data\UpsertPickupPoint $command): \Commerz\Shipping\PickupPoints\Data\PickupPointView;
```

### DeliveryRate {#type-commerz-shipping-rates-contracts-deliveryrate}

`Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Contracts\DeliveryRate`

How much a method charges for a parcel in a zone.

```php
interface DeliveryRate {
    const KIND = 'delivery_rate';
    // Contribution key, e.g. `flat` or `acme.zone_matrix`.
    key(): string;
    // Validates the parameters and returns them in canonical form.
    normalize(\Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams $params, \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateScope $scope): \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams;
    // Does not write and makes no network call; time comes from `$input->request->context->at`.
    price(\Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateInput $input): \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RatePrice;
    // Brings parameters stored at an older version to the current one.
    upgrade(\Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams $params, int $fromVersion): \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams;
    // The current version of the parameter schema, at least 1.
    version(): int;
}
```

### RateInput {#type-commerz-shipping-rates-data-rateinput}

`Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateInput`

What a rate prices. `$request->parcel->value` is the value of the goods after discounts; in a quote the stage recomputes it. `$currency` is the currency of the tariff and `$zoneCode` the zone the address was matched to.

```php
final readonly class RateInput {
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency;
    public readonly \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams $params;
    public readonly \Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\DeliveryRequest $request;
    public readonly string $zoneCode;
    __construct(\Commerz\Ports\Delivery\Data\DeliveryRequest $request, \Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams $params, \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency, string $zoneCode);
}
```

### RateParams {#type-commerz-shipping-rates-data-rateparams}

`Commerz\Shipping\Rates\Data\RateParams`

The parameters of a rate as a canonical JSON-safe map: keys sorted, `Money` as `{amount_minor, currency}`, enums as their value, dates as ISO-8601 UTC. No floats and no other objects, so what is stored is what was meant and two equal configurations are equal byte for byte. A field is named `key` or `key.<index>.<sub>`.

```php
final readonly class RateParams {
    static fromInput(array $input): self;
    // Parameters read from the database (decoded JSON): the same canonical form as `fromInput`.
    static fromStored(array $stored): self;
    int(string $key, int $min = \PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = \PHP_INT_MAX): int;
    list(string $key, int $min, int $max): array;
    money(string $key, \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency): \Commerz\Money\Money;
    nullableInt(string $key, int $min = \PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = \PHP_INT_MAX): ?int;
    // Refuses a parameter that is not in the list, so a typo does not pass as a rate that does nothing.
    only(array $keys): self;
    toArray(): array;
}
```

### Zones {#type-commerz-shipping-zones-contracts-zones}

`Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Contracts\Zones`

Delivery zones: sets of countries, regions and postal prefixes. Zones may overlap; the most specific match wins.

```php
interface Zones {
    // Archiving an archived zone changes nothing. @throws ZoneNotFound
    archive(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ArchiveZone $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
    create(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\CreateZone $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
    find(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneId $id): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
    list(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ListZones $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Restoring an active zone changes nothing. @throws ZoneNotFound
    restore(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\RestoreZone $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
    // Replaces the member set.
    setMembers(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\SetZoneMembers $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
    update(\Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\UpdateZone $command): \Commerz\Shipping\Zones\Data\ZoneView;
}
```
